nodes.name: Solution Oxidation of Copper Foam

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of CeNiFe LDH
nodes.procedure: The Ce-decorated NiFe (CeNiFe) LDH is attached onto the CuO surface by one-step electrodeposition. The optimized parameters are a deposition time of 300 s and a 5% Ce addition proportion.
nodes.source_text: the optimized fabrication parameters for CeNiFe@CuO are chosen to be 300 s and 5% Ce addition.

nodes.name: Electrodeposition of NiFe LDH
nodes.procedure: NiFe LDH is attached onto the CuO surface by one-step electrodeposition without Ce species addition.
nodes.source_text: Finally, the Ce-decorated NiFe (CeNiFe) LDH ... is attached onto the CuO surface ... By varying the deposition time ... and deposited elemental proportion ... to select the best ... NiFe@CuO

nodes.name: Electrodeposition on Nickel Foam
nodes.procedure: CeNiFe LDH nanosheets are deposited on nickel foam using the same one-step electrodeposition method used for the CuO substrate samples.
nodes.source_text: the CeNiFe LDH nanosheets are deposited on nickel foam to avoid signal interference from the OER and the Cu/Cu2+ reoxidation reaction

nodes.description: OER performance in alkaline simulated seawater (1 M KOH + 0.5 M NaCl)
nodes.source_text: The NiFe@CuO displays moderate activity with overpotentials of 294 and 312 mV to deliver current densities of 300 and 500 mAcm−2 in SW... after the incorporation of Ce, at the current density of 500 mAcm−2, the overpotential is only 271 mV... the CeNiFe@CuO electrode demonstrating the lowest calculated Tafel slope... 72.5 mV dec−1 in SW... After 300 h of high current OER above 500 mA cm−2 in SW, the response current density of CeNiFe@CuO remains stable.

The CeNiFe@CuO can achieve high current density of 500 mA cm−2 with overpotential of 265 and 280 mV in KOH and alkaline natural seawater... demonstrating the lowest calculated Tafel slope (71.5 mV dec−1 in KOH).
